title: Paths devbin prints for a Homebrew keg name libexec's launcher, which a PATH without Homebrew's bin refuses at the bash floor (from 0253's review)
body:
On macOS, 0253 makes a brewed devbin run under a PATH without Homebrew's bin (cron, a hook a GUI app starts) through the keg's bin/devbin, an env script that puts the formula's bash first. The paths devbin prints for a keg name libexec's launcher instead, whose shebang is `#!/usr/bin/env bash`, so from that same PATH they lead back to the floor's refusal. Found by dc's critic-shell review of the 0253 bank (4ee0621a). vc ruled it outside 0253's scope and filed it on 2026-10-27.

## Measured

- dc's critic built a scratch keg whose bin/devbin was written by Homebrew's own write_env_script, and ran it under `env -i` from `PATH=/usr/bin:/bin` (~/Devel/scratch/devbin-dc/0253/review/probes/e2e/help.out). Its `help` exits 0, and both its seed line and its `Run:` line name `<prefix>/opt/devbin/libexec/bin/devbin`.
- That launcher's shebang is `#!/usr/bin/env bash`, so from the same PATH it runs on /bin/bash 3.2 and is refused at the floor, as issue 0253 measured of every brewed invocation before its fix.
- vc read where the path comes from, on main at 53c11520:
  - launcher_shown (lib/helpers:3727-3734) prints `devbin` only when the devbin on PATH is the install's launcher, and otherwise `$(install_named_root <root>)/bin/devbin`, which for a keg is `<prefix>/opt/devbin/libexec/bin/devbin`. help's seed line (bin/devbin:276) and DEVBIN_INVOKE for an install tree (bin/devbin:514), which the hints, refusals and overview print, ask it. From `PATH=/usr/bin:/bin` no devbin is on PATH, so these name the libexec path.
  - dvb's machine-install fallback (lib/cmd/shell-init:163-167) runs `$prefix/bin/devbin`, where _shell_init_prefix fills the prefix from install_named_root for an install (lib/cmd/shell-init:215-221).

## Fix

For a keg, the launcher devbin names is the keg's own bin/devbin by its opt link, `<prefix>/opt/devbin/bin/devbin`. One function beside brew_opt_root spells it, so the formula's layout keeps one spelling. On macOS that is the env script, and on Linux the link to libexec's launcher. launcher_shown's fallback and dvb's fallback ask it, and the opt-link strings that 0251's and 0252's arms hold (machinepointer.bats, shellinit.bats) follow. A root that is not a keg is named as it is now, and the install root itself (`--from`, the upgrade remedy) stays libexec.

## Done when

1. For a keg, launcher_shown and dvb's fallback name `<prefix>/opt/devbin/bin/devbin`, from the one function. Arms hold each, red on main.
2. A scratch-tap install, made as decision 81 (3) makes 0253's, runs the printed path's `--version` at exit 0 under `env -i` from `PATH=/usr/bin:/bin`, and the Resolution records it.
3. The landing suite passes under BSD and GNU (helpers, machinepointer and shellinit, with the tree scans and help), and CI is green on the pushed head.

It builds after 0253, on 0253's env script.

## Resolution

0266 is fixed by f172b06f (tree 2f81bdb7), the fourth and last of the line's commits on 6bb2e15c (0251 cdd2f186, then 0253 8e39dc89, then 0262 b0ea3fe0, then 0266). 6bb2e15c is the PRE: the version chain's tip 1792ae25 with main's 0257 (landed on main as f3cbab33) picked, and it is not landed again. The chain under the line has since landed on main (0259 1229314e, 0260 e6fd4a98, 0263 4a9bd32e, 0264 ce5d39e1, 0265 7c814e93), and main's code outside intent/ equals 6bb2e15c. l7 was built because 0253 was amended (0253's Resolution says why). f172b06f has the same stable git patch-id as its predecessor in l6, 992cd9d8. It builds on 0253's env script. f172b06f is the line's tip, the tip the landing run tested.

### The design as built

- lib/helpers, in the one spelling of the formula's layout: `brew_opt_link <prefix>` names Homebrew's opt link, `<prefix>/opt/devbin`, and brew_opt_root now builds on it (`<opt link>/libexec`).
- `install_launcher_root <root>` names the tree whose bin/devbin is the launcher to print. For a keg, which brew_keg_prefix recognises by its Cellar path (`*/Cellar/devbin/*/libexec`), it is the opt link itself; any other root is named as it is, an install at a path that only ends opt/devbin/libexec included. A keg run through its opt link arrives by its Cellar path, since PROJECT_ROOT is read physically.
- launcher_shown's fallback prints `<install_launcher_root>/bin/devbin`. lib/cmd/shell-init's _shell_init_prefix bakes install_launcher_root's answer into dvb, which runs `$prefix/bin/devbin` as before.
- The install itself, which `--from` and the upgrade remedy name, is still install_named_root's libexec.
- The issue asked for one function that spells `<prefix>/opt/devbin/bin/devbin`. As built, brew_opt_link spells the opt link, install_launcher_root is the one rule both readers ask, and each reader appends `bin/devbin` where it did.

### What changed, against "Done when"

1. **[x] For a keg, launcher_shown and dvb's fallback name `<prefix>/opt/devbin/bin/devbin`, from the one function. Arms hold each, red on main.**
   - launcher_shown: machinepointer.bats' "run in Homebrew's install, the refusal's seed and upgrade lines name the opt link ... (0195, 0251, 0252, 0266)" (the refusal's seed line, with the upgrade line still `--from <prefix>/opt/devbin/libexec`) and "run from Homebrew's keg, install's --force remedy and the refusal's seed line name devbin or the opt link, never the keg (0252, 0266)". Both are red on the base, which prints `<prefix>/opt/devbin/libexec/bin/devbin`.
   - dvb's fallback: shellinit.bats' "an install Homebrew placed is baked into dvb by its opt link ... (0195, 0252, 0266)" asserts `${DEVBIN_INSTALL_PREFIX:-'<prefix>/opt/devbin'}` and runs the dvb it baked, `dvb --version`, from outside every project. "run from Homebrew's keg, the usage's rc lines name devbin or the opt link ... (0252, 0266)" holds the rc lines. Both are red on the base, which bakes and prints the libexec path.
   - The help seed line, help's `Run:` line and `devbin devbin`'s seed line are held by three 0251 arms that carry 0266. The help arm runs the printed launcher's `--version` and checks it answers `(brew,`. Those are red on the base at exit 5, which is 0251's reason, since 0251 is not on the base. The critic measured 0266's half on 0266's own parent, which carried 0251: it printed the libexec launcher in help's seed and `Run:` lines and in the refusal's seed line.
   - A root that is not a keg is named as it is: "an install published at a path that only ends opt/devbin/libexec is no keg, so its help names its own launcher, which runs (0266)".
2. **[x] A scratch-tap install, made as decision 81 (3) makes 0253's, runs the printed path's `--version` at exit 0 under `env -i` from `PATH=/usr/bin:/bin`, and the Resolution records it.** Accepted by vc (2026-10-28). It rides the line's local-tap proof, which ran the opt path's `--version` at exit 0 under `env -i` from `PATH=/usr/bin:/bin`, but did not read that path from devbin's output: the scratch formula is named devbin-dc, so brew_keg_prefix's `*/Cellar/devbin/*` does not match its keg. The arms hold the printed line.
   - The proof (vc decision 81(3)) ran on stage 7's tip e3c9c8bb, which carries the line, in slot 01M60MCSZMXN00RHE45661P2N1, END 06:54:28Z on 2026-10-28, released. Under `env -i` and `PATH=/usr/bin:/bin` it ran `/opt/homebrew/opt/devbin-dc/bin/devbin --version`, the keg's own bin/devbin by its opt link, at exit 0, answering as devbin. It also seeded a project with `/opt/homebrew/opt/devbin-dc/bin/devbin install --into <project>` from that PATH, at rc 0.
   - That is the path 0266 prints for a keg in its shape, `<prefix>/opt/<formula>/bin/devbin`. But the scratch formula is renamed devbin-dc, and brew_keg_prefix recognises only `*/Cellar/devbin/*/libexec`, so devbin would not have printed this path for the scratch keg. The proof shows that the keg's launcher, by its opt link, runs from the cron PATH. It does not show that devbin printed it. That the printed line is that launcher is what the arms in Done when 1 hold.
   - Output: ~/Devel/scratch/devbin-dc/b0254/tap-proof-01M60MCSZMXN00RHE45661P2N1-2.out. Its cleanup read back that the scratch keg, its opt link and the tap are gone. hv's devbin keg and link and the bash keg are byte-identical before and after.
3. **[x] The landing suite passes under BSD and GNU (helpers, machinepointer and shellinit, with the tree scans and help).** CI on the pushed head is vc's landing to read.

- lib/cmd/shell-init's header and lib/pages/shell-init.md say the baked default is the opt link, whose bin/devbin dvb runs, and why it is never libexec. They also say DEVBIN_INSTALL_PREFIX, when set, still names an install root, so inside dvb the variable and the baked default name different trees of one keg.
- packaging/homebrew/devbin.rb's comment says devbin's hints, help's seed line and dvb name a keg by its bin/devbin through the opt link.

### The critic review

- The critic-shell subagent reviewed the bank, 77d767f9..92fc0abc: 0 critical, 3 warning, 3 recommendations and 1 style. The settlement (84301a19) settled it. The line carries it as the one commit f172b06f.
  - **WARNING (a non-keg install at a path ending opt/devbin/libexec named a launcher that does not exist):** the bank's `brew_opt_prefix` matched any such path by its spelling and mapped it to the directory above, whose bin/devbin is not there (exit 127). Taken: brew_opt_prefix is deleted, and install_launcher_root asks brew_keg_prefix alone, as install_named_root does. The new non-keg arm holds it. 0253/review/probe-0266settle.out measured it: before the settlement the opt-shaped install's seed launcher exits 127, after it exits 0, and the keg's seed launcher runs in both.
  - **WARNING (Highlander: brew_opt_prefix re-spelled the layout):** cleared by the same deletion.
  - **WARNING (lib/pages/shell-init.md stale):** taken, as above.
  - **Recommendation (one variable, two kinds of value):** taken as rewording. The header and the page say the baked default and DEVBIN_INSTALL_PREFIX name different trees of one keg. The review's other option, baking the install root and having dvb run the launcher from it, needed a ruling and was not taken.
  - **Recommendation (devbin.rb's comment):** taken.
  - **Recommendation (red-control: the arms asserted a launcher their fixture did not build):** taken. brew_keg now gives the keg its own bin/devbin, linked to libexec's launcher as the formula writes it on Linux. The help arm runs the printed launcher, the shell-init arm runs the dvb it baked, and the non-keg arm runs its own launcher.
  - **Style (dead `opt` locals):** taken; the arms that no longer use it do not declare it.
- **Amended during settlement** (l4, make-l4.sh): since brew_keg now links the keg's bin/devbin, two arms built on it broke, as 0270's builder found. 0251's remedies arm linked it a second time (`ln: File exists`), and 0253's env_script_keg wrote its script through that link, over libexec's launcher. The amend drops the second `ln -s`, and env_script_keg removes the link before it writes the script.
- **The critic leg** ran `intent critic shell` on the line's changed shell (12 files, lib/helpers and lib/cmd/shell-init among them) and exited 0. It asked 2 of the 6 shell rules.

### Which arms are red on main, and which hold unchanged behaviour

- **Red on 6bb2e15c, for the issue's reason:** machinepointer.bats' 0195 arm and its `--force` remedy arm, and shellinit.bats' baked-prefix and rc-line arms. Each expects `<prefix>/opt/devbin/bin/devbin` or the opt link baked, where the base prints and bakes the libexec path.
- **Red on 6bb2e15c for 0251's reason:** the three 0251 arms that carry 0266, and the new non-keg arm. Each exits 5 on the base, which has no install help, before its 0266 assertion is reached.
- **Hold unchanged behaviour:** the upgrade remedy's `--from <prefix>/opt/devbin/libexec`, asserted in the 0195 arm. The install root is still libexec.

    - helpers (115), dispatch (121), machinepointer (35), formula (34), use (30), shellinit (38), localinstall (62), contract (43), fleet (155) and install (103, its one case-folding skip);
    - help (58).

  - The tree scans ran under GNU, and every test passed: neutral (10), documentation (28), readonlygit (11), harness (34, its two expected skips), vendoredmd (3), workroom (5) and installhints (1). helpers and contract ran whole under both.
